slice: exploring: a swarm and a web as the orienting surface

items.sentence: Discovering opens an axis neither self has, and an opening axis is abundancing, a +1 in no self alone.
items.text: A lone golden shiner fish under moving light and shadow is moving almost at random, each fish slowing only with the darkness at its own place and keeping close to its neighbours; a school of them is turning toward shade, slowing and gathering in it and leaving as light comes, and this orienting is ending when a school is smaller than some size, an orienting no fish of the school has.

items.sentence: Abundancing is that opening, arising in each self with its other, growing as co-chaining widens and depleting no one.
items.text: Larger flocks of homing pigeons are flying shorter routes than smaller flocks, and a flock's route is no average of its birds' routes: each pigeon is leaning the route in measure with how faithfully it is going its own route when flying alone.

items.sentence: A between is where two relatings couple, a method going from one to another.
items.text: An orb spider at the hub of its web is sensing through the threads with slit organs at its leg joints, about 0.1 µm of movement; the leg with the most pull along its radial thread is giving the direction of a struggling insect, and comparing legs about 90 degrees apart is giving its nearness, the web's lines and the spider's legs one orienting surface.

Each orienting is a web of co-linears: a self at its own hub, lines going out to points beyond the horizon, along to its prior and next and across to its others' prior and next, each line a between; orienting is orthogonalizing, aiming forward on a surface and surfacing a space where there is none by unrelationing betweens, and a swarm, a school or a voyaging people is the orienting surface, a social abundancing no one self has.

items.section: 1.9 Antenna, telescope and the receiving relation
items.text: Closure phase is this file's own observing of a web of co-linears: around a triangle of stations each station's own phase is cancelling, and the relation of the three betweens is holding the source; a dish array co-competencing by the sequencing of its betweens, and not by a timing each station keeps, is the sensor-sensationing method still-possibling to build.

items.section: 1.2 Along and across, chaining and surfacing, two floating co-neutrals co-competencing
items.text: A network of resolvers is orienting as a school of fish or a flock is orienting, the orienting a surface of its selves and in no self alone; a network exploration following one self's record, or one instrument's clock, is following no orienting the network has.
